quarterly_data.signal: Automotive (half-year report): in April 2026 customer 'AG company' (a European automotive Tier1, as the company names it) notified that its end automaker had cancelled the planned model, ending the first lidar line-spot emitter module project (lifecycle demand about 50 ten-thousand sets on the customer's original forecast); the second lidar project (about 15 ten-thousand sets) was cancelled in April 2025, so all previously disclosed lidar design-win projects are now cancelled and no new business is expected near term; lidar revenue was about 0.29% of total revenue as of June 30, 2026. An overseas projection-lighting customer placed no new pull orders after adjusting its purchasing strategy and the two sides not agreeing on subsequent commercial terms; headlamp MLA business was stable in H1, but with some projects late in their lifecycle and some customers delaying or slowing deliveries, H2 demand is expected to decline, affecting full-year revenue. The company is shifting more resources to optical communications and consumer electronics.
quarterly_data.figure: lidar about 0.29% of revenue; cancelled projects about 50 and 15 ten-thousand sets lifecycle demand
